scope: Root actually viewed all six reconstructed final frames and the paired raw theater frame from the final package after the Shedd context/camera correction. This is sampled still inspection alongside the independent 32-frame numeric motion test, not an all-frame visual claim.
findings: Dome star and aurora detail remains unchanged while seat speckle is substantially reduced. No visible polar sliver in the sampled frame.
Field Hall arches, suspended gardens and skeleton remain legible; spatial smoothing preserves broad material boundaries.
Shedd glass and gold crowns retain fine sampling grain at eight samples; the two habitats and aisle are clear.
Adler gallery floor is quieter, with retained projection doorway and slender supports.

Night harbor and broad convention roofs remain subdued; finite dock, promenade and pylon lamps are visible. These are low-sample motion proofs; high-sample final stills and exported movies are reviewed separately.
